function.name: evaluate_ethical_guardrail
function.description: Evaluates user prompts, conduct profile, and request metadata against Apostil 13 / Red Letter Ethical Guardrails before executing an action.

user_input.description: The raw user prompt or instruction to evaluate for structural and ethical safety.

conduct_profile.description: The evaluated behavioral context or sentiment profile.

is_beneficial_to_other.description: Indicates if the requested action is mutually beneficial or serves the recipient (Rule 01 Reciprocity).

override_active.description: Whether owner override mode is active. Absolute life preservation remains enforced.
